description: A 2HP colour picker with knobs and control voltage for hue, saturation, lightness and transparency, four jacks carrying them as voltages, and a colour for a Null, Info or PanelTone beside it

params.text: Sets the hue of the colour, 0 to 360 degrees
Sets the saturation of the colour, 0 to 1
Sets the lightness of the colour, 0 to 1
Sets the transparency of the colour, 0 fully transparent and 1 fully opaque

inputs.text: Moves the hue away from the knob setting, a tenth of a full turn per volt, wrapping round at either end
Moves the saturation away from the knob setting, 0.1 per volt, clamped at 0 and 1
Moves the lightness away from the knob setting, 0.1 per volt, clamped at 0 and 1
Moves the transparency away from the knob setting, 0.1 per volt, clamped at 0 and 1

outputs.text: The hue, 0-10V over a full turn

notes: no cable is needed for the main job: the colour is handed to a Null, Info or PanelTone standing beside it, with Share color as Extender on here and the matching option on in that module
the blue lamp is lit while Share color as Extender is on and there is a module on one side or the other
a cable from another Copper or Copper-mini output is taken as the value itself rather than as an offset from the knob, so the two track each other exactly
an input taking an offset reads the signal as bipolar once the voltage goes below 0V, and as unipolar once it goes above 5V, subtracting 5V in that case
bypassing the module passes each input straight through to the output for the same colour part
every knob is also a click control: click to step up, Cmd-click on Mac or Ctrl-click elsewhere to step down, Shift for a bigger step
the module underneath is the one Copper uses; this panel leaves out the hue strip, the lightness and saturation square, and the red, green, blue and poly outputs
the modulated colour is shown as a hex code above the colour sample at the bottom
menu: Palette color — sets the colour from a list of named colours
Color — opens a colour picker for the colour, transparency included
Share color as Extender — allows this module to set the colour of a Null, Info or PanelTone beside it; F2 over the module does the same
Copy hex color — copies the chosen colour to the clipboard as a hex code
Paste hex color — sets the colour from a hex code on the clipboard

inputs.0:
±10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the HUE knob; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
inputs.1:
±10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the SAT knob; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
inputs.2:
±10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the LUM knob; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
inputs.3:
±10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the ALPH knob; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
